name: Bachs
tagline: Payments and billing platform for internet businesses, settling to African bank accounts.
description: Bachs is a full payments and billing platform combining global checkout, subscription billing, usage-based billing, tax handling, and settlement to African bank accounts (NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR) in one integration. Supports cards, mobile money, bank transfer, and stablecoin (USDT/USDC) checkout across Africa, Europe, and North America.
